name: Zul'Gurub: Bloodlord Mandokir whirls once every 25 seconds, on foot and on Ohgan's back alike
contract: The live CoA combat log of 2026-08-02 (Normal kill) shows Mandokir's (11382) Whirlwind (2118408) every
25.0-25.2 s, also in cycles where he charges nobody; with a charge target it begins as the charge lands
(tester, 2026-11-04). His charges come 10.4 s into the pull, then 25 and 50 s apart in turn, so every
third 25 s slot is a Whirlwind alone (user decision 2026-11-16, charges on foot). With nobody out of
melee every slot is a Whirlwind (3 s cast): about 10 and 35 s in on foot, and about 60 s in on Ohgan's
back, since he mounts from 55 s. The third slot is the Whirlwind-only one, so a script that skipped it
would whirl only twice; an older script whirled twice per 25 s cycle. The hero stands in melee in the
arena and stops attacking, so there is no charge target and no gaze punishment.

steps.label: Into Mandokir's arena, 30 yards in from the entrance
CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub on Normal
the first Whirlwind comes about 10 s in, in the first charge's place
Wait past the older script's second whirlwind 8 s after the charge
DISCRIMINATING: only one Whirlwind in the first 25 s slot
the second Whirlwind comes 25 s after the first
CONTROL: he mounts Ohgan from 55 s
DISCRIMINATING: the third, Whirlwind-only slot comes 25 s after the second
CONTROL: he whirled on Ohgan's back
CONTROL: one Whirlwind per slot, no more
